exchanges: ok big news i finally got the job at halverson clinic!!
Congratulations, that's huge news!
still kinda in shock tbh, i applied on a whim
Sometimes the whim applications are the ones that land.
only downside is my sciatica is flaring so sitting all day is gonna suck
Oof, a good chair and some stretch breaks might help.
dara dragged me to her fencing class last night lol i was terrible
Being terrible at the first class is basically tradition.
my legs are so sore from it
Sounds like a proper workout, hope they recover quick.
my aunt maren called, shes a taxidermist so she always has the weirdest stories
That job must come with some unforgettable stories.
also our cat marzipan learned to open the cupboard
Uh oh, a cat who can open doors is a whole new problem.
found her sitting in the cereal box this morning
That's an adorable crime scene.
my sister switched her major to geology, mom is not thrilled
Rocks are a cool thing to study, hopefully your mom comes around.
anyway what should i make for dinner, i have rice and like one onion
A simple fried rice with that onion could work nicely.
the cat is a chartreux so shes basically a chunky grey potato
Chunky grey potato is a perfect description.
funny thing, the maren next door is a locksmith, so two marens with odd jobs
Two Marens with unusual trades is a fun coincidence.
she helped me when i locked myself out last spring
Very handy neighbour to have.
started piranesi last night and i cant put it down
It's a strange, gripping one, enjoy it.
stayed up way too late reading
That's the sign of a good book.
my cousin is moving to lisdoon for some farm job
That's a big change, hope it goes well for them.
so now i have to help pack a truck on saturday ugh
Pizza as payment is the standard rate for moving help.
dara offered to bring her old saab to haul boxes
Every bit of trunk space helps on moving day.
feelin a bit tired today honestly
Go easy on yourself, it's been a busy week.
at least the ferry ride to work will give me time to read
A boat commute with a book sounds pretty great.
weather looks gross tomorow tho
Bring a good raincoat for the crossing.
ok first day outfit, jeans or nice pants
Nice pants for day one, then you can read the room.
grabbing breakfast at bramblewick first, their scones are unreal
A good scone is the right way to start a new job.
ok going to bed early, wish me luck
Good luck, you're going to do great!
